class TestR04:
    def test_invalidate_many_any_union(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x', 'y'])
        c.put('c', 3, ['y'])
        c.put('d', 4, ['z'])
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x', 'y'], mode='any') == 3
        assert len(c) == 1
        assert c.get('d') == 4

    def test_invalidate_many_all_intersection(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x', 'y'])
        c.put('c', 3, ['y'])
        c.put('d', 4, ['x', 'y', 'z'])
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x', 'y'], mode='all') == 2
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert c.get('a') == 1 and c.get('c') == 3

    def test_invalidate_many_default_mode_any(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x', 'y']) == 2
        assert len(c) == 0

    def test_invalidate_many_single_tag_matches_invalidate(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x', 'y'])
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x']) == c.invalidate('y') + 1
        assert len(c) == 0

    def test_invalidate_many_empty_tags_remove_zero(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        assert c.invalidate_many([], mode='any') == 0
        assert c.invalidate_many((), mode='all') == 0
        assert c.invalidate_many(iter([]), mode='any') == 0
        assert c.invalidate_many((t for t in []), mode='all') == 0
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert c.get('a') == 1 and c.get('b') == 2

    def test_invalidate_many_dedup_all_mode(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        # duplicates collapse; 'x','x' is just 'x'
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x', 'x'], mode='all') == 1
        assert len(c) == 1
        assert c.get('b') == 2

    def test_invalidate_many_distinct_keys(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x', 'y'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x', 'y'])
        # both modes remove the same two distinct keys
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x', 'y'], mode='any') == 2
        c.put('a', 1, ['x', 'y'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x', 'y'])
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x', 'y'], mode='all') == 2
        assert len(c) == 0

    def test_invalidate_many_no_match(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        assert c.invalidate_many(['q', 'r'], mode='any') == 0
        assert c.invalidate_many(['q', 'r'], mode='all') == 0
        assert len(c) == 1
        assert c.get('a') == 1

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_mode", ['both', 'ANY', 'All', None, 1, ('any',)])
    def test_invalidate_many_invalid_mode_rejected_before_mutation(self, bad_mode):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            c.invalidate_many(['x'], mode=bad_mode)
        assert len(c) == 1
        assert c.get('a') == 1
        assert c.invalidate('x') == 1

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_tags", ['xy', ['x', 3], 42, None, [b'x']])
    def test_invalidate_many_invalid_tags_rejected_before_mutation(self, bad_tags):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            c.invalidate_many(bad_tags, mode='any')
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            c.invalidate_many(bad_tags, mode='all')
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert c.get('a') == 1 and c.get('b') == 2

    def test_invalidate_many_generator_tags(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        assert c.invalidate_many((t for t in ['x', 'y']), mode='any') == 2
        assert len(c) == 0

    def test_invalidate_many_tags_consumed_once(self):
        consumed = []

        def gen():
            for t in ['x', 'y']:
                consumed.append(t)
                yield t

        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        c.invalidate_many(gen(), mode='any')
        assert consumed == ['x', 'y']  # exactly one pass

    def test_invalidate_many_cleans_tag_state(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x', 'y'])
        c.invalidate_many(['x'], mode='any')
        # 'a' is gone; 'y' must not linger
        assert c.invalidate('y') == 0
        assert len(c) == 0

    def test_invalidate_single_still_compatible(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x'])
        assert c.invalidate('x') == 2
        assert len(c) == 0


class TestR05:
    def test_resize_shrink_evicts_lru_first(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['ta'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['tb'])
        c.put('c', 3, ['tc'])
        c.get('a')  # 'a' MRU; LRU order: b, c, a
        c.resize(2)
        assert c.maxsize == 2
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert 'b' not in c  # LRU evicted first
        assert 'c' not in c
        assert c.get('a') == 1
        # tags of survivors intact, evicted tags gone
        assert c.invalidate('ta') == 1
        assert c.invalidate('tb') == 0
        assert c.invalidate('tc') == 0

    def test_resize_shrink_preserves_lru_order(self):
        c = TaggedCache(4)
        c.put('a', 1)
        c.put('b', 2)
        c.put('c', 3)
        c.get('a')  # order: b, c, a
        c.resize(2)  # evicts b, c -> survivors a, ? wait only a survives? no: len 3 -> 2 evicts b then c
        assert len(c) == 2
        # survivors: a (MRU) and... len was 3, resize to 2 evicts LRU b, then c? c is newer than b
        # LRU order after evicting b: c, a -> evict c -> only a? that's len 1
        # recompute: entries a,b,c; resize(2) evicts until len==2: evict b (LRU), then c (now LRU)
        # so only 'a' remains? No: 3 entries -> need 2, evict 1: only b evicted.
        assert c.get('a') == 1
        # now 'c' is LRU, 'a' MRU
        c.put('d', 4)
        assert 'c' not in c
        assert c.get('a') == 1 and c.get('d') == 4

    def test_resize_grow_no_eviction(self):
        c = TaggedCache(2)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        c.resize(5)
        assert c.maxsize == 5
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert c.get('a') == 1 and c.get('b') == 2
        assert c.invalidate('x') == 1
        assert c.invalidate('y') == 1

    def test_resize_same_size_noop(self):
        c = TaggedCache(3)
        c.put('a', 1)
        c.resize(3)
        assert c.maxsize == 3
        assert len(c) == 1
        assert c.get('a') == 1

    def test_resize_to_one(self):
        c = TaggedCache(3)
        c.put('a', 1)
        c.put('b', 2)
        c.get('a')
        c.resize(1)
        assert c.maxsize == 1
        assert len(c) == 1
        assert c.get('a') == 1
        assert 'b' not in c

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [0, -1, True, False, 2.5, '3', None, [2]])
    def test_resize_invalid_preserves_all_state(self, bad):
        c = TaggedCache(3)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        c.get('a')  # order: b, a
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            c.resize(bad)
        assert c.maxsize == 3
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert c.get('b') == 2 and c.get('a') == 1
        assert c.invalidate('x') == 1
        assert c.invalidate('y') == 1

    def test_resize_invalid_preserves_lru_order(self):
        c = TaggedCache(2)
        c.put('a', 1)
        c.put('b', 2)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            c.resize(0)
        # 'a' still LRU
        c.put('c', 3)
        assert 'a' not in c
        assert c.get('b') == 2 and c.get('c') == 3

    def test_resize_then_put_uses_new_capacity(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        for i in range(5):
            c.put('k%d' % i, i)
        c.resize(2)
        assert len(c) == 2
        c.put('new', 99)
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert c.get('new') == 99

    def test_maxsize_property_reports_current_capacity(self):
        c = TaggedCache(2)
        assert c.maxsize == 2
        c.resize(7)
        assert c.maxsize == 7
        c.resize(1)
        assert c.maxsize == 1


class TestR06:
    def test_generator_tags_consumed_once(self):
        seen = []

        def gen():
            for t in ['x', 'x', 'y']:
                seen.append(t)
                yield t

        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, gen())
        assert seen == ['x', 'x', 'y']  # exactly one consumption pass
        assert c.invalidate('y') == 1
        assert len(c) == 0

    def test_generator_tags_exhausted_after_put(self):
        it = iter(['x', 'y'])
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, it)
        assert next(it, _STOP) is _STOP  # fully consumed
        assert c.invalidate('x') == 1
        assert c.invalidate('y') == 0

    def test_detached_nested_across_repeated_gets(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', {'d': {'n': [1, 2]}, 'l': [{'i': 3}]})
        v1 = c.get('a')
        v1['d']['n'].append(99)
        v1['l'][0]['i'] = -1
        v1['extra'] = True
        v2 = c.get('a')
        assert v2 == {'d': {'n': [1, 2]}, 'l': [{'i': 3}]}
        assert v1 is not v2 and v1['d'] is not v2['d']
        assert v1['d']['n'] is not v2['d']['n']

    def test_detached_nested_across_puts(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        v = {'d': [1, 2]}
        c.put('a', v)
        v['d'].append(3)  # mutate original after put
        v1 = c.get('a')
        assert v1 == {'d': [1, 2]}
        v1['d'].append(4)
        v2 = c.get('a')
        assert v2 == {'d': [1, 2]}
        # replace with a fresh nested value; old detached copies unaffected
        c.put('a', {'d': [9]})
        assert v2 == {'d': [1, 2]}
        assert c.get('a') == {'d': [9]}

    def test_deep_copy_not_shallow(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', {'list': {'inner': {'deep': [0]}}})
        out = c.get('a')
        out['list']['inner']['deep'].append(1)
        assert c.get('a') == {'list': {'inner': {'deep': [0]}}}
